# Report (results v1)

The score in every table below is **guideline conformance**: the share of applicable deterministic checks a file passes. Each check cites vendor guidance or literature (grade `G`); none is yet backed by an experiment in this repository. A high score does not mean the file makes an agent better, and no table here ranks files. See [limitations](limitations.md) before quoting any number.

## 1. Corpus

| type | files | lines median (min–max) | words | bytes | approx. tokens (chars/4) | files ≤ 200 lines |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| project | 13 | 137 (39–560) | 1007 (214–4334) | 7503 (1388–30720) | 1870 (347–7662) | 9 |
| generic | 3 | 133 (65–206) | 1051 (358–1678) | 7831 (2357–10404) | 1957 (586–2601) | 2 |
| all | 16 | 135 (39–560) | 1029 (214–4334) | 7667 (1388–30720) | 1914 (347–7662) | 11 |

Lines, words, bytes and approximate tokens are medians with min–max in parentheses. Approximate tokens are characters divided by four, not a tokenizer.

## 2. Check catalog

| id | rule | applies to | grade | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `len-lines` | At most 200 lines | all | G | [^anthropic-memory], [^humanlayer] |
| `len-bytes` | At most 32 KiB (Codex default project_doc_max_bytes) | all | G | [^openai-agents-md] |
| `cmd-test` | A test command is given verbatim | project | G | [^agents-md-spec], [^anthropic-bp] |
| `cmd-single` | A way to run a single test is given | project | G | [^anthropic-bp] |
| `cmd-lint` | A lint or typecheck command is given | project | G | [^anthropic-bp] |
| `cmd-build` | A build command is given | project | G | [^agents-md-spec] |
| `rule-destructive` | A guard against destructive or irreversible operations | all | G | [^agent-readmes], [^ssojet] |
| `rule-secrets` | A rule about handling secrets | all | G | [^anthropic-bp] |
| `rule-injection` | Instructions found in files, logs, or tool output are treated as data | all | G | [^anthropic-bp] |
| `verify-done` | Completion is tied to a runnable verification | all | G | [^anthropic-bp] |
| `etiquette` | Commit, branch, or pull-request conventions exist | all | G | [^anthropic-bp] |
| `pointers` | Points to further documents instead of inlining them | all | G | [^anthropic-memory], [^humanlayer] |
| `no-overview-dump` | No architecture or directory-overview section longer than 40 lines | all | G | [^eth-agents-md], [^anthropic-bp] |
| `emphasis` | Emphasized lines are at most max(3, 5% of lines) | all | G | [^anthropic-bp] |
| `vague` | No unverifiable adjectives (properly, clean code, best practices, ...) | all | G | [^anthropic-memory] |
| `tool-leak` | A cross-tool AGENTS.md does not reference one tool's private paths | agents-md | G | [^anthropic-memory] |
| `pointer-file` | The repository wires Claude Code to the shared file (CLAUDE.md is @AGENTS.md) | manifest | G | [^anthropic-memory] |

Measurement checks (`measure-*`) feed table 1 and are not scored.
